name: Dwarven Temple
desc1: This large temple is ornately decorated with carved stonework and
desc2: tall statues. Comfortable beds for the sick and injured are placed
desc3: against the walls, and are mostly unused for it is rare for a dwarf to
desc4: fall ill. Ewers of fresh water are readily available, and a chest of
desc5: healing poultices and herbs awaits the healer's use.
